Force Activate
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ecAdminActivateStatus/forcedActivate

Force activates configuration changes.

Responses
​
default

Default Response. See API Response Codes

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
orgEditStatus
string

Organization policy edit status.

Possible values: [EDITS_CLEARED, EDITS_PRESENT, EDITS_ACTIVATED_ON_RESTART]

orgLastActivateStatus
string

Organization policy last activation status.

Possible values: [CAC_ACTV_UNKNOWN, CAC_ACTV_UI, CAC_ACTV_OLD_UI, CAC_ACTV_SUPERADMIN, CAC_ACTV_AUTOSYNC, CAC_ACTV_TIMER]

adminStatusMap
object
adminActivateStatus
string

Admin activation status.

Possible values: [ADM_LOGGED_IN, ADM_EDITING, ADM_ACTV_QUEUED, ADM_ACTIVATING, ADM_ACTV_DONE, ADM_ACTV_FAIL, ADM_EXPIRED]
